description: This file defines a client class for Amazon Cognito Identity service, extending the AwsClient class, and including method annotations for various API operations related to Cognito Identity. It serves as a wrapper to interact with AWS Cognito Identity using PHP.

classes.name: CognitoIdentityClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Cognito Identity service, providing methods to manage identities and identity pools.

methods.name: CognitoIdentityClient
methods.description: Constructs an instance of the client class for AWS Cognito Identity.
